overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the chair's discretion to limit a speaker's time at the June 28 joint meeting was upheld, though public participation is encouraged. Claims against the Water Commissioners were not reviewed.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleges he was not allowed to address the Board at a June 28 joint meeting with the Water Commissioners; the chair cut his speaking time short.
allegations.key_passage: Because it is within the chair's discretion to limit public participation during a meeting, we find no violation of the Open Meeting Law with respect to this allegation.

allegations.summary: Complainant's underlying claim that the Water Commissioners later redacted executive session minutes outside a noticed meeting was raised but not reviewed.
allegations.key_passage: We will therefore do not review any allegations against other public bodies in this letter.
